name: grupoexito.com.co
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But buttons must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every button text or an aria-label, so a screen reader can announce it.
summary: www.grupoexito.com.co scores 68 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 27 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: 103 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 103 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /es, /es/proveedores, /es/landing-podcast, /es/quienes-somos and 93 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 9 elements on /es, /es/proveedores, /es/landing-podcast, for example .menu-exito__hamburger and .menu-dots__hamburger. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: 39 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.evidence: /es/proveedores → /en/suppliers, /es/quienes-somos → /en/about-us, /es/historia → /en/history, /es/negocios-marcas → /en/business-brands and 35 more. Search engines will usually index the other URL instead.
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 97 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Meta Pixel (2 requests), Google Analytics (2 requests), Google Ads (1 request), and cookies __Secure-YNID on youtube.com, YSC on youtube.com, VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE on…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 27 elements on /es, /es/proveedores, /es/landing-podcast, for example .valor-accion-text-widget and .valor-accion-value-widget. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.
